findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker sends specially crafted input that includes shell metacharacters or command separators (e.g., semicolon, pipe, ampersand).
findings.assumptions: The buffer content is later used in a system call or command execution without proper validation or sanitization.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: An attacker sends more data than the size of the buffer (1024 bytes).
findings.assumptions: The buffer size is fixed and the received data is not checked for length before being processed.
